card.name: Linking words before titles and names
card.fires_on: Small linking words (and, of, as, commas, were) right before a title, proper name, or named item in web text, especially after a work or list of works like The Hobbit.

modes.description: The word 'and' or a comma that joins titles of books or films in a list.

modes.description: Words like 'of' or 'as' that lead into a named document, place or example.
